Polk-Hoffhine Directory Co.'s Tulsa City Directory 1921

Embracing a complete alphabetical list of business firms and private citizens; a miscellaneous directory of city and county officials; churches; public and private schools, banks, asylums, hospitals and homes commercial bodies, secret societies, street and avenue guide, etc., etc.
